spans.s: ऋषि m. 1. An inspired poet or sage; 2. an anchorite; 3. a ray of light.
ऋषि-तर्पण n. a libation offered to the sages.
ऋषि-पंचमी f. name of a festival on the fifth day in the first half of the month of Bhādrapada.
ऋषि-लोक m. the world of the Ṛshis.
ऋषि-स्तोम m. 1. praise of the Ṛshis; 2. a particular sacrifice completed in one day.
